title: Hooded Mage at Enchanted Door
description: A hooded figure in a blue cloak stands before a massive wooden door set into an ancient stone castle wall, casting a spell that emits bright blue magical sparks from their outstretched hand. The arched doorway is covered in glowing runes, chains, and padlocks, with a lit lantern above and various papers, apples, and a wagon wheel scattered around the weathered stone battlements under a dramatic twilight sky.
